statement:
Researchers must personally check every
citation an AI tool gives them before they
submit a paper.

AI makes it easier for non-native English
speakers to compete in science publishing.

AI-polished writing is erasing scientists'
personal and cultural voices.

Plain-language AI summaries of research do
more good than harm, even when they lose
nuance.

Journals should use AI as the first reviewer
on every submitted paper.
